verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an observability and incident-management SaaS with an API, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions a sandbox, test mode or isolated non-production environment. The AI SRE approval gate and team-scoped API tokens are related controls but are not sandbox isolation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
